summary.prose: Building s5 moves the terminal UI onto the daemon's model definitions. It starts with three small foundations: the shared IPC client stops hanging when the daemon drops a connection, Ollama model definitions gain an optional memory figure, and config.write refuses per-repo tier settings. On top of a new Services.models facade, the Setup recommendation, the Model Tiers pane with its unknown-model check screen, the Repos models view, the command bar and the review command are moved to the daemon's answers, and finally the TUI's temporary model lists are removed and the literal scan is widened to cover the TUI.
